text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The exact-match research paper. Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project page** — Companion site for the same work. It presents EAU as a meta-agent that modifies the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration while training is underway. Same authors and affiliations as above.  
   URL: [eau-meta-agent.github.io](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith review of EAU** — An automated independent review and paper breakdown. It highlights the reported performance gains but questions unmatched compute budgets and reliance on proprietary meta-agents. Researchers reviewed: Min Cai, Dan Zhang, Gao Xing, Libin Ma, Zhaohui Xu, and Xi Ye, with the affiliations listed above.  
   URL: [Pith review](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page** — The first author’s page identifies EAU as current work on continually learning agents and confirms that Cai is a PhD student at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye.  
   URL: [Min Cai](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

1. **Official arXiv paper — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”** Submitted October 12, 2026. Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (Independent Researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Min Cai’s research page.** Lists EAU among Cai’s agent-training research. People: Min Cai, a University of Alberta PhD student; Xi Ye, University of Alberta/Amii, is identified as Cai’s supervisor.  
   URL: [henrycai11.github.io](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

3. **Pith’s AI-generated review of EAU.** Covers the same six authors and affiliations above. It finds the approach promising but flags unmatched compute budgets and reliance on proprietary meta-agent models as important limitations.  
   URL: [pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The exact-match research paper introducing a meta-agent that jointly adapts the environment, user simulator, rewards, and RL configuration. Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project page** — Companion website referenced by the paper. It concerns the same authors and affiliations listed above.  
   URL: [eau-meta-agent.github.io](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Independent paper overview and AI review** — Pith’s summary highlights EAU’s reported gains while questioning whether its baseline comparisons use matched compute budgets. People and affiliations are the same research team listed in result 1.  
   URL: [Pith](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page** — The first author’s page lists EAU under agent training. Min Cai is a PhD researcher at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye.  
   URL: [henrycai11.github.io](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

These results primarily point to one underlying work, submitted to arXiv on October 12, 2026.
